inspiration.observed_pattern: A text expression with an explicit binary collation must compare case-sensitively against a string literal.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced independently to one UTF-8 label row and one utf8mb4_bin equality projection; the source schema, values, and application context are removed while the collation-sensitive comparison remains observable.

fixture_notes: The stored lowercase label must not equal the differently cased Alpha literal under utf8mb4_bin; this isolates the original mismatch from the case-folded comparison and multiple rows.
determinism_notes: One fixed label and one fixed literal make the comparison deterministic with no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules.
setup: CREATE TABLE mini_collation_labels (label_id INT PRIMARY KEY, label_text VARCHAR(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT label_text COLLATE utf8mb4_bin = 'Alpha' AS binary_match FROM mini_collation_labels
